_comment: Upscaling models for ai_upscale/upscale.py. Any model spandrel can load works; add an entry here or pass a file path to --model. sha256 is checked after download.

ultrasharp-v2.note: Default. Sharpest of the ones compared, faithful on objects, faces and catalogue pictures; adds some detail of its own (e.g. stained glass).

pbrify-v4.note: Trained on 2000s game textures; natural wood/foliage, slightly softer than UltraSharp. No licence conditions.

drct-mssim.note: No GAN: invents nothing, but soft. Runs in fp32 (no bf16 support in some ops).

x4plus.note: 2021 baseline; painterly, invents bright grout lines on tiles.
